item.text: [{"task_id":"6bcdb01e","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['colors'][0]))","    obstacle = int(round(params['colors'][1]))","    ink = int(round(params['colors'][2]))","    directions = [(int(round(v[0])), int(round(v[1]))) for v in params['directions']]","    perpendicular = int(round(params['perpendicular'][0]))","    out = grid.copy()","    height, width = grid.shape","    seeds = np.argwhere(grid == ink)","    queue = []","    for position in seeds:","        r, c = int(position[0]), int(position[1])","        for d in range(len(directions)):","            dr, dc = directions[d]","            aligned = False","            for sign in (-1, 1):","                nr, nc = r + sign * dr, c + sign * dc","                if 0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width and grid[nr, nc] == ink:","                    aligned = True","            if aligned:","                queue.append((r, c, d))","    seen = set()","    cursor = 0","    while cursor < len(queue):","        r, c, d = queue[cursor]","        cursor += 1","        state = (r, c, d)","        if state in seen:","            continue","        seen.add(state)","        dr, dc = directions[d]","        nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc","        if not (0 <= nr < height and 0 <= nc < width):","            continue","        value = int(grid[nr, nc])","        if value == background or value == ink:","            out[nr, nc] = ink","            queue.append((nr, nc, d))","        elif value == obstacle:","            for nd in range(len(directions)):","                tr, tc = directions[nd]","                if dr * tr + dc * tc == perpendicular:","                    queue.append((r, c, nd))","    return out"],"shapes":{"colors":[3],"directions":[4,2],"perpendicular":[1]},"params":{"colors":[7,8,3],"directions":[[0,1],[0,-1],[1,0],[-1,0]],"perpendicular":[0]},"rationale":"Extend the green seed along its axis. Whenever a ray meets an azure obstacle, launch both perpendicular rays from the preceding cell. Rays stop at grid boundaries; visited directional states prevent cycles."}]
